infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Echo Finders plays the echoes of the place you are standing in, so it needs to know where you are.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Echo Finders uses the camera so you can hold up your phone and see which echoes are around you.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Echo Finders plays the echoes of the place you are standing in, so it needs to know where you are.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: So echoes can open with your phone in your pocket and the screen off, while you walk and listen. Echo Finders works without this: you would keep the app on screen instead.
